aplikacije: aplikacija — app; attachment; gen. case / pl.
buk: Veliki buk — Lisine waterfall; buk — waterfall, sound of water
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
danu: dan — day; loc. case; u jednom danu — in one day
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
ko: ko zna — who knows; colloquial abbreviation of kao — «how»
kraju: kraj — end; na kraju — in the end, ultimately
krupajsko: Krupajsko vrelo — karst spring in eastern Serbia
manasiju: Manasija — monastery XV centuries; acc. case
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
mora: morati — to be supposed to; 3rd pers. sg.
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
preko: preposition + gen. case: preko reke — beyond the river; preko puta — opposite
resavske: Resavska pećina — cave in eastern Serbia; gen.
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
smo: biti, 1st pers. pl.: stigli smo — we arrived
spustili: spustiti se — to go down; past, pl.
srbiji: Srbija; loc. case: u Srbiji — in Serbia
ti: pronoun; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
četiri: numeral; četiri i po — four and a half
